'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jesse Clark DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jesse Clark]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' CPI Funball
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
